rows.en: Celica: "H-Hey, hey! Could you come with me for a bit?"
Touya: "Huh? You barge in without even knocking,
and that's the first thing you say?"
Touya: "All right, all right! Stop pulling my hand."
Touya: "...Why on earth did you bring me to the hangar...?"
Celica: "You just don't appreciate its functional beauty, Touya...
Touya: "H-Hey! What the hell is this?!"
Celica: "What do you mean? It's a next-generation biological analyzer,
Touya: "I don't know what's next-generation about it,
but that name certainly sounds suspicious."
Celica: "You think so? But with this machine,
in an instant, your body, Touya, down to the genetic level,
can be analyzed. It's that good.
This means your Prana aptitude, Touya,
and why your synchronization rate with Spirit Mechs is so high
...Anyway, just sit down and give it a try."
Touya: "I feel like my life's in danger, so I'll pass."
Celica: "It'll be fine! Don't you trust me?"
Fain: "Oh! If it isn't the princess.
There seems to be some disagreement. Is something wrong?"
Fain, try sitting in here for a moment."
Celica: "What? Do you have a problem with it?"
Understood. You want me to get in, then."
Touya: "...Don't say I didn't warn you..."
I have a strange feeling of dread..."
Celica: "It's your imagination. Your imagination! Activate!"
Touya: "H-Hey... I get the feeling something terrible
Well, it's Fain. I'm sure he'll be all right, so let's leave it
Celica: "Whaaat?! Just for a little while, come on!"
Touya: "I've got a bad feeling, so I'll pass."
Celica: "Ugh. All right, fine. Forget it."
Touya: "At times like this, it's best to trust

Gene-level instant analysis/Prana aptitude/high synchronization explanation are Celica claims hedged probably, not proved medical/engineering capability. Preserve eight dots25 and sixteen dots45, all source row boundaries/names. Chest-unease idiom is dread not diagnosed cardiac symptom. Fain cries then silent, not confirmed dead; Celica confidence not objective safety. No unprinted body exposure, intimate act, specific injury or actual device procedure. Follow/refusal alternatives distinct, no game choice auto-selected.
